newsitem.title: USA: Eight bidders for 370 tonnes of US stockpiled tin.
newsitem.headline: Eight bidders for 370 tonnes of US stockpiled tin.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it received bids from eight companies for a total of 370 tonnes of Longhorn grade tin.
The lowest bid was $2.593 per pound for 20 tonnes from M C Canfield. The highest bid was $2.70 per pound for 5 tonnes from Tin International.
LME cash tin settled at the equivalent of $2.62 per pound on Wednesday. LME deliverable tin is of higher grade than Longhorn.
